purpose: Permit one new Weekly publication on its actual non-Wednesday publication day to replace a visibly stale current pointer, while preserving the ordinary Wednesday cadence and archived Weekly identity.

correctivePublication.reason: Correct the stale current Weekly pointer without backdating or future coverage.

requiredAuthorizationFields: publicationDate equal the candidate date and Vancouver today at publisher execution
coveredPeriod start/end, both real Vancouver dates, ending on publicationDate
one-time authorization identity and exact checksum binding
explicit statement that the cadence resumes on the next Wednesday

exactProductionChanges.change: Add an explicit corrective-date mode. It must require a policy binding and a closed period ending on the actual current Vancouver day; select only approved Daily records whose Vancouver publication day falls inside that closed period. Keep the default Wednesday-to-Wednesday branch byte-for-byte semantically unchanged.

Accept a non-Wednesday date only when a checksum-bound correctivePublication object matches the exact authorization, the date is Vancouver today, the closed period ends today, and the current pointer is older than the period. Preserve the normal Wednesday-only branch for every unbound candidate. Persist the corrective metadata and deterministic note with the dated coverage period.
Permit a current non-Wednesday Weekly only when its complete corrective metadata validates the same narrow invariant. Continue rejecting all unbound non-Wednesday dates.
Add the optional corrective metadata shape if schema validation covers the public publication record; require it when a current Weekly editionDate is not Wednesday.

Add calibrated accepts for the exact authorized Sunday fixture and rejects for missing/altered authorization, future/partial period, non-today correction, Wednesday candidate using corrective bypass, stale prior mismatch, and replay. Retain existing Wednesday assertions.

publicationInvariants: The new Weekly is a new published record; do not alter or relabel the August 26 Weekly.
The public pointer moves only after the exact full Weekly admission chain passes.
The correction covers August 31 through September 6 inclusive in America/Vancouver, never September 7–9.
The next ordinary Weekly remains Wednesday September 9 and must use its own closed Wednesday-to-Wednesday coverage window.
The policy cannot become a general non-Wednesday scheduling path.
currentCandidateGaps: No complete Weekly story object or hero visual.
No exact-prose producer review, independent review, source-evidence bindings, claim map, or content manifest.
No implementation or calibrated tests for the narrow non-Wednesday exception.
nextActions: Root creates and binds the one-time corrective policy after deciding the exact public label.
Producer drafts one closed-period Weekly only after the producer contract passes.
Run full existing Weekly review/admission chain, then the new calibrated corrective gate tests.
Publish only with the exact candidate on September 6; otherwise leave the old Weekly truthful but visibly dated and use the normal September 9 route.
